name: Taking Care Of Neighbors
overview: Scripture commands believers to love their neighbors as themselves, emphasizing mercy and kindness as key expressions of this love. Leviticus 19:18 and Matthew 22:39 clearly establish this as a divine mandate, while Proverbs 3:27 and 14:21 urge withholding good from no one and showing mercy especially to the poor. Jesus further illustrates this in Matthew 25 by identifying care for the hungry, thirsty, and strangers as acts done unto Him, highlighting the eternal significance of neighborly compassion.
